title: Sonship in Christ
definition: Sonship in Christ is the believer's new standing as a child and heir of God through union with Jesus.
summary: Sonship in Christ is the believer's adopted identity as a child of God through union with the Son.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the eternal Son who brings redeemed people into the Father's family.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Sonship speaks to belonging, inheritance, access, discipline, and love. In Christ, believers are not merely pardoned criminals; they are welcomed children who cry, 'Abba, Father.' This doctrine gives warmth and relational depth to salvation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many know God only as Judge or distant authority. Sonship shows that the Father brings redeemed sinners into His household through the Son. It heals orphaned thinking and strengthens prayer, assurance, and obedience.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Approach God as Father through Christ, not as a stranger trying to earn permission. Let adoption reshape shame, fear, and loneliness. Treat other believers as family members loved by the same Father.
